column1: # windows-baseline-ports.csv — Baseline port profile for Windows hosts.
# Deployed to C:\ProgramData\agent_patches\config\baseline_ports.csv by
# deploy.sh (from WINDOWS_BASELINE_PORTS) and loaded by
# check_security_posture to classify listening ports beyond the current
# posture snapshot/diff. Edit this file to match your fleet's real baseline
# -- the shipped defaults are a starting point covering common Windows
# services and well-known risky ports
# every role (domain controller
# Columns: port
#   protocol: tcp or udp
#   severity: "baseline"  -- expected on every host of this OS type
#                            flagged even if it appears in the report.
#             "info"/"warning"/"critical" -- a known port that is always
#                            flagged at this severity when found listening
#                            regardless of baseline status. The agent still
#                            weighs the host's stated system purpose before
#                            treating a flagged port as an incident.
# Any listening port matching no row at all is reported as an unclassified
# deviation from baseline
port
